transforms.code:
# UX PRE-FLIGHT ONLY -- see Global Constraint 6. Every check below is
	# re-run by Workorder.DieCastShiftReconciliation_Save, which refuses
	# authoritatively. This list exists so Save can say WHY it is disabled
	# rather than failing on click.
	U  = BlueRidge.Common.Util
	st = U.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.state) or {}
	hd = U.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.header) or {}
	act = st.get("actual") or {}
	lots = st.get("lotLines") or []
	rejs = st.get("rejectLines") or []
	moves = st.get("moves") or []
	lotsRows = U.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.lots) or []
	lotsById = {}
	for lr in lotsRows:
		lid = lr.get("LotId")
		if lid is not None:
			lotsById[lid] = lr
	out = []

	if st.get("reasonId") is None:
		out.append("Choose a reason for this reconciliation.")
	elif BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCastReconciliation.reasonRequiresNote(
			st.get("reasonId")) and not (st.get("note") or "").strip():
		# Save line 498 refuses this. Without the mirror the operator gets a
		# clean-looking sheet, an enabled button, and a refusal on click.
		out.append("This reason needs a note saying what happened.")

	hasLines = len(lots) > 0 or len(rejs) > 0
	total = act.get("totalShots")
	good  = act.get("goodShots")
	warm  = act.get("warmUpShots")

	# Save line 904: refused when moves, the LOT plan and scrap are all empty
	# and the actual total is unset. A sheet with a reason picked and nothing
	# else touched -- no LOT line, no reject line, no move, no actual figure
	# -- satisfies every clause of that refusal, and nothing else below
	# checks for it since there is no line to gate on.
	if (not hasLines and not moves
	        and total is None and good is None and warm is None):
		out.append("Nothing to save: the record already matches actual.")

	# ---- reject lines (Save sec 8) -- independent of the actual totals; a
	# bad reject line is refused whether or not the totals are filled in. ----
	if rejs:
		activeCodeIds = set()
		warmCodeId = None
		for dc in (BlueRidge.Quality.DefectCode.getAll() or []):
			activeCodeIds.add(dc.get("Id"))
			if (dc.get("Code") or "") == "999":
				warmCodeId = dc.get("Id")

		badWarm = False
		for r in rejs:
			if r.get("defectCodeId") == warmCodeId:
				badWarm = True
		if badWarm:
			# Save line 705. The reject dropdown can't filter this out on its
			# own -- DefectCode_List / getForDropdown don't carry
			# IsNonRejectScrap -- so this is the only gate in front of it.
			out.append("Warm-up is entered as warm-up shots, not as a reject line.")

		badLine = False
		for r in rejs:
			qty = r.get("quantity")
			if qty is None or qty < 0 or r.get("defectCodeId") not in activeCodeIds:
				badLine = True
		if badLine:
			# Save line 708.
			out.append("A reject line has an unknown reason or a missing amount.")

		# Save lines 730-738: the span check only runs once every line above
		# has passed -- one bad line refuses the whole batch before the span
		# math is ever reached, so mirror that instead of dividing by garbage.
		if not badWarm and not badLine:
			cavRows = U.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.cavities) or []
			spanZero = False
			badSpan = None
			for r in rejs:
				itemId = r.get("itemId")
				if itemId is None:
					span = len(cavRows)
				else:
					span = 0
					for c in cavRows:
						if c.get("ItemId") == itemId:
							span += 1
				if span == 0:
					spanZero = True
				elif badSpan is None and (r.get("quantity") or 0) % span != 0:
					badSpan = (r.get("quantity") or 0, span)
			if spanZero:
				out.append("A reject line names a part that no cavity on this die was making during this shift.")
			elif badSpan is not None:
				out.append("%s does not divide evenly across %s cavities. Enter it against each part instead."
				           % (badSpan[0], badSpan[1]))

	# ---- LOT lines (Save sec 7) -- independent of the actual totals; a bad
	# LOT line is refused whether or not the totals are filled in. ----
	if lots:
		badQty = False
		for l in lots:
			qty = l.get("quantity")
			if qty is None or qty < 0:
				badQty = True
		if badQty:
			# Save line 587.
			out.append("Every LOT needs an actual quantity of zero or more.")

		badNewQty = False
		for l in lots:
			if l.get("lotId") is None and l.get("quantity") == 0:
				badNewQty = True
		if badNewQty:
			# Save line 658.
			out.append("A new LOT needs a quantity above zero.")

	# A11: LOT or reject lines require the three actual totals; a save with
	# only moves does not -- the checks below cannot run without them.
	# Save line 780 also refuses a NEGATIVE actual figure alongside a missing
	# one -- the numeric inputs carry a min of 0 too, but that only stops new
	# typing, not an already-staged negative.
	if hasLines and (total is None or good is None or warm is None
	                 or total < 0 or good < 0 or warm < 0):
		out.append("Enter the actual total shots, good shots and warm-up shots.")
		return out

	if total is not None and good is not None and warm is not None:
		# EQUALITY, not ">". Save line 782 is `IF @Total <> @Good + @Warm` and
		# refuses either way. A ">"-only mirror leaves total=900 good=750
		# warm=12 with an empty blocker strip and an enabled Save that then
		# fails on click, against a rule the operator was never shown.
		if good + warm != total:
			out.append("Total shots %s should equal good shots %s + warm-up %s = %s. One of them has a typo."
			           % ("{:,}".format(total), "{:,}".format(good),
			              "{:,}".format(warm), "{:,}".format(good + warm)))
		cav    = hd.get("ActiveCavities") or 0
		if cav == 0:
			# Save line 701. Without this the zero silently makes expected
			# negative and surfaces as a baffling LOT-sum message instead.
			out.append("This die had no active cavities during this shift, so there is nothing to reconcile against.")
			return out
		noGood = sum([(r.get("quantity") or 0) for r in rejs])
		expected = good * cav - noGood
		lotSum   = sum([(l.get("quantity") or 0) for l in lots])
		if lots and lotSum != expected:
			out.append("LOT list totals %s; actual total good is %s. One of them has a typo."
			           % ("{:,}".format(lotSum), "{:,}".format(expected)))
		for l in lots:
			if (l.get("quantity") or 0) > good:
				out.append("%s is %s pieces, more than the shift's %s good shots."
				           % (l.get("ltt"), "{:,}".format(l.get("quantity") or 0),
				              "{:,}".format(good)))

		# Save lines 883-892: per-LOT below-what-was-used and released-to-zero
		# guards. Recorded here is this LOT's own read, not move-adjusted the way
		# the Save's @Rec is -- an approximation this pre-flight already makes
		# elsewhere (see header). Skipped for a brand-new LTT (no lotId yet):
		# Recorded is 0 and quantity is never negative, so Gap can never be < 0.
		for l in lots:
			lotId = l.get("lotId")
			if lotId is None:
				continue
			lotRow = lotsById.get(lotId)
			if lotRow is None:
				continue
			recorded = lotRow.get("Recorded") or 0
			gap = (l.get("quantity") or 0) - recorded
			pieceCount = lotRow.get("PieceCount") or 0
			invAvail = lotRow.get("InventoryAvailable") or 0
			statusCode = lotRow.get("StatusCode") or ""
			isLocked = bool(lotRow.get("IsLocked"))
			applyToLot = (statusCode == "Open" and not isLocked)
			correctCount = (statusCode == "Good" and not isLocked)
			if gap < 0 and (applyToLot or correctCount) and (pieceCount + gap < 0 or invAvail + gap < 0):
				# Save line 887.
				out.append("Taking %s down that far would go below what has already been used from it."
				           % (l.get("ltt") or "that LOT"))
			if correctCount and gap != 0 and pieceCount + gap <= 0:
				# Save line 892.
				out.append("A released LOT cannot be corrected to zero: %s. Scrap or void it from LOT Detail."
				           % (l.get("ltt") or "that LOT"))
	return out

customMethods.name: sheetKey
customMethods.script:
# The shift / press / die this sheet is pointed at RIGHT NOW. load()
	# stamps this into view.custom.state as "sheetKey", and applyState()
	# compares a snapshot's stamp against it before writing the snapshot
	# back, so a handler that was in flight when the sheet moved cannot
	# restore the previous shift's draft over the one now on screen.
	return "%s/%s/%s" % (self.view.params.shiftId,
	                      self.view.params.cellLocationId,
	                      self.view.params.toolId)

customMethods.name: applyState
customMethods.script:
# The ONLY place view.custom.state is written outside load(), and the
	# guard is the whole point of it. Every caller does an unguarded
	# read-modify-write of the WHOLE state object, and load() replaces that
	# object wholesale on every param change -- so a handler still holding a
	# pre-load snapshot (an ActualInput's onBlur, an addLtt waiting on
	# resolveLtt) would write the PREVIOUS shift's LOT and reject lines back
	# over the shift now on screen. header, cavities and reviewAndSave's
	# payload are already the NEW shift's by then, so the sheet reads as this
	# shift while carrying the other one's LOTs -- a Honda traceability
	# record against the wrong shift and die. Refuse the write: the sheet the
	# team lead typed into is gone, so there is nothing left to save into it.
	# Diagnosed 2026-10-02.
	want = (st or {}).get("sheetKey")
	now  = self.sheetKey()
	if want != now:
		BlueRidge.Common.Util.log(
			"stale sheet write refused: snapshot=%s now=%s" % (want, now),
			level="warn")
		return False
	self.view.custom.state = st
	return True

customMethods.name: load
customMethods.script:
shiftId = self.view.params.shiftId
	cellId  = self.view.params.cellLocationId
	toolId  = self.view.params.toolId
	if shiftId is None or cellId is None or toolId is None:
		# LEAVING THE SHEET -- the parent nulls all three params on
		# reconcileBackToShifts, and this embed is REUSED, never unmounted.
		# A bare return here left the whole staged sheet (LOT lines, reject
		# lines, moves, reason, note) alive in view.custom.state for the life
		# of the page, which is also what made "Discard & Close" discard
		# nothing: the only thing that ever cleaned the sheet was the NEXT
		# completed load(). Clear it here instead, so no stale sheet is left
		# for a later load() to race with. Diagnosed 2026-10-02.
		self.view.custom.state = {
			"actual": {"totalShots": None, "goodShots": None, "warmUpShots": None},
			"reasonId": None,
			"note": "",
			"moves": [],
			"lotLines": [],
			"rejectLines": [],
			"loadedStamp": "",
			"sheetKey": self.sheetKey(),
		}
		self.view.custom.pristineStateJson = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
		self.view.custom.entries      = []
		self.view.custom.lots         = []
		self.view.custom.rejects      = []
		self.view.custom.cavities     = []
		self.view.custom.lttInput     = ""
		self.view.custom.lttCavityId  = None
		self.view.custom.isEmptyShift = False
		return
	R = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCastReconciliation
	header   = R.getHeaderOrEmpty(shiftId, cellId, toolId)
	# IsStaged / StagedToShiftLabel are display-only fields this screen adds on
	# top of the SQL row -- entries is the flex-repeater's own bound source, so
	# stageMove()/undoMove() rewrite it in place to make the cards re-render
	# (a direct property write retriggers the binding; refreshBinding() from a
	# handler does not).
	# EnteredAtDisplay is pre-formatted to a STRING here, once, while EnteredAtEt
	# is still a real Date fresh off Common.Db -- stageMove()/undoMove() detach
	# entries through a JSON round trip, which does not preserve a Date's type,
	# so a card reading dateFormat() on the post-stage value renders "null".
	entries = []
	for r in (R.listEntries(shiftId, cellId, toolId) or []):
		d = dict(r, IsStaged=False, StagedToShiftLabel='')
		d["EnteredAtDisplay"] = (system.date.format(d["EnteredAtEt"], "MM/dd HH:mm")
		                         if d.get("EnteredAtEt") else "")
		entries.append(d)
	lots     = R.listLots(shiftId, cellId, toolId)
	rejects  = R.listRejects(shiftId, cellId, toolId)
	cavities = R.listCavities(shiftId, toolId)
	self.view.custom.header        = header
	self.view.custom.entries       = entries
	self.view.custom.lots          = lots
	self.view.custom.rejects       = rejects
	self.view.custom.cavities      = cavities
	self.view.custom.reasonOptions = R.reasonOptions()
	# Reject block's Approved-by dropdown -- ALL ACTIVE Location.AppUser rows
	# (every person has one from first PIN sign-in, so a QAS signer always
	# resolves), plus a leading Unapproved/blank choice: an unapproved reject
	# line is legitimate and becomes its own NULL-approver row (spec sec 6.2).
	# Pure projection onto the existing Users-screen helper -- no new named
	# query, no business logic.
	approverOptions = [{"label": "Unapproved", "value": None}]
	for u in (BlueRidge.Location.AppUser.getUserList() or []):
		name = u.get("DisplayName") or u.get("Initials") or ("User %s" % u.get("Id"))
		initials = u.get("Initials") or ""
		label = ("%s (%s)" % (name, initials)) if initials else name
		approverOptions.append({"label": label, "value": u.get("Id")})
	self.view.custom.approverOptions = approverOptions
	# Reject line rows reseed their local edit-copy from params whenever this
	# changes (mirrors DieCastEntry/DieWideLineRow's seedToken) -- a fresh load
	# is always a full structural reset. LotLineRow's seedToken (lotLinesSeed) mirrors this --
	# a fresh load is a full structural reset there too, and without this the
	# flex-repeater can reuse an instance across two loads with the same LOT-row
	# count (open shift A, go back, open shift B on the same press) and every
	# Actual field would keep showing the PRIOR shift's numbers.
	self.view.custom.rejectLinesSeed = 0
	self.view.custom.lotLinesSeed = 0

	# RESET THE LTT ENTRY BAR. This embed is REUSED across presses -- the
	# parent rewrites params and the component never remounts -- so without
	# this a cavity picked on one die survives into the next die's sheet,
	# and addLtt's `res.get("ToolCavityId") or lttCavityId` short-circuits
	# straight onto the stale value.
	#
	# The cross-die case is the SAFE one: the Save's cavity-ownership check
	# refuses a cavity that was not on this die. The dangerous case is the
	# SAME die -- reconcile one shift picking cavity b, open another shift on
	# that die, and the stale b PASSES ownership and silently attributes the
	# production to the wrong cavity on a Honda traceability record. A
	# one-cavity die hides it completely, because the dropdown is not shown
	# and addLtt's own "Choose a cavity" guard can never fire.
	#
	# Diagnosed 2026-10-01 on DM0144 (Machine 202, one cavity) with a
	# temporary trace: rawLttCavityId=2 -- a DMO125 cavity -- reached FINAL
	# cavityId=2 on Tool 12.
	self.view.custom.lttCavityId = None
	self.view.custom.lttInput = ""
	# A shift with NOTHING on record is the Machine 202 case this screen exists
	# for. Say so explicitly -- an empty screen must never be mistaken for a
	# failed load.
	self.view.custom.isEmptyShift = (len(entries) == 0 and len(lots) == 0
	                                 and len(rejects) == 0)
	# Who the banner's "Reconciling as" line names -- not in the brief's custom
	# block; Step 4 needs a name + initials and header carries neither. Resolved
	# the same way every mutation on this screen will attribute itself, so the
	# banner can never name someone other than who Save credits.
	# The banner names WHO THIS SAVE WILL BE ATTRIBUTED TO, and that is
	# exactly session.custom.user: set by the PIN sign-in, and REPLACED by
	# the supervisor for the length of an elevation window. Already the right
	# answer, with no lookup.
	#
	# NOT Common.Session.currentAppUserId(): that is the MUTATION-attribution
	# resolver and it fires an ERROR TOAST ("Not saved / No one is signed in")
	# whenever nobody is attributed -- a scary toast on every load of a
	# read-only banner, on every load where no AD IdP exists, and in prod any
	# time an elevation lapses before the sheet mounts. It also cost an
	# AppUser.getUser round trip per load, and load() runs once per param.
	#
	# Reading scalars off the session wrapper is safe; it is read-modify-write
	# of a whole property object that silently loses writes.
	# GUARDED, and the guard is the point. This is a COSMETIC banner lookup
	# sitting upstream of the single load-bearing state write below. A session
	# property read returns a live property-tree wrapper, not a dict; it
	# normally supports .get(), but this project has at least one documented
	# case of a map-like value where .get() raises and only bracket access
	# works. If that happened here, load() would die BEFORE seeding state and
	# loadedStamp -- so the sheet would have no stale guard and no draft, from
	# a failure to render somebody's name. Bracket access with a catch-all
	# mirrors the on-point precedent in Common/Session (resetTerminal), and a
	# blank name is a cost worth paying to keep the load alive.
	name = ""
	initials = ""
	try:
		u = self.session.custom.user
		if u:
			name = u["displayName"] or ""
			initials = u["initials"] or ""
	except:
		BlueRidge.Common.Util.log("banner: could not read session.custom.user",
		                          level="warn")
	self.view.custom.currentUser = {"name": name, "initials": initials}
	# ONE property write. Seeding state in two steps lets a dirty binding
	# observe a half-loaded sheet and latch. The LOT lines start at their
	# RECORDED value so an untouched LOT contributes its existing number and
	# the totals reconcile before anything is typed.
	self.view.custom.state = {
		"actual": {"totalShots": None, "goodShots": None, "warmUpShots": None},
		"reasonId": None,
		"note": "",
		"moves": [],
		"lotLines": [{"lotId": r.get("LotId"), "ltt": r.get("Ltt"),
		              "toolCavityId": r.get("ToolCavityId"),
		              "quantity": r.get("Recorded"), "isNew": False}
		             for r in lots],
		"rejectLines": [{"defectCodeId": r.get("DefectCodeId"), "itemId": r.get("ItemId"),
		                 "quantity": r.get("Quantity"),
		                 "approvedByUserId": r.get("ApprovedByUserId"), "isNew": False}
		                for r in rejects],
		"loadedStamp": header.get("Stamp") or "",
		# Which sheet this draft belongs to. applyState() refuses any
		# read-modify-write whose snapshot carries a different one.
		"sheetKey": self.sheetKey(),
	}
	# Snapshot for the Discard dirty-check (ConfirmUnsaved pattern) -- a plain
	# JSON-string compare against this only needs to be current at the moment
	# Discard is clicked, so a live binding would be more machinery than the
	# question needs.
	self.view.custom.pristineStateJson = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)

customMethods.name: stageMove
customMethods.script:
p = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(payload) or {}
	entryKey  = p.get("entryKey")
	toShiftId = p.get("toShiftId")
	entry = None
	for e in (self.view.custom.entries or []):
		if e.get("EntryKey") == entryKey:
			entry = e
			break
	if entry is None or toShiftId is None:
		return

	def ids(csv):
		return [int(x) for x in (csv or "").split(",") if x.strip()]

	# The Save takes one element PER ROW, not per entry. The grouping into
	# entries is presentation; ContributionIds / RejectIds are the real targets,
	# which is what stops a wrong grouping ever producing a wrong write.
	staged = [m for m in (self.view.custom.state.moves or [])
	          if m.get("entryKey") != entryKey]
	for cid in ids(entry.get("ContributionIds")):
		staged.append({"entryKey": entryKey, "entityType": "Contribution",
		               "entityId": cid, "toShiftId": toShiftId})
	for rid in ids(entry.get("RejectIds")):
		staged.append({"entryKey": entryKey, "entityType": "Reject",
		               "entityId": rid, "toShiftId": toShiftId})

	st = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
	st = system.util.jsonDecode(st)
	st["moves"] = staged
	if not self.applyState(st):
		return

	# Card display join. entries is the flex-repeater's own bound source, so
	# rewriting it (not refreshBinding, which no-ops from a handler) is what
	# makes the cards re-render with their staged state.
	toShiftLabel = p.get("toShiftLabel") or ""
	ej = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.entries or [])
	entries = system.util.jsonDecode(ej)
	for row in entries:
		if row.get("EntryKey") == entryKey:
			row["IsStaged"] = True
			row["StagedToShiftLabel"] = toShiftLabel
	self.view.custom.entries = entries

customMethods.name: undoMove
customMethods.script:
if not entryKey:
		return

	st = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
	st = system.util.jsonDecode(st)
	st["moves"] = [m for m in (st.get("moves") or []) if m.get("entryKey") != entryKey]
	if not self.applyState(st):
		return

	ej = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.entries or [])
	entries = system.util.jsonDecode(ej)
	for row in entries:
		if row.get("EntryKey") == entryKey:
			row["IsStaged"] = False
			row["StagedToShiftLabel"] = ""
	self.view.custom.entries = entries

customMethods.name: addRejectLine
customMethods.script:
# A fresh typed line, unapproved and unpicked -- the team lead fills it in.
	# The reject block's grain is (DefectCode, Part, Approver): a blank line
	# does not collide with anything because it carries no defect code yet.
	# isNew=True -- only a line the team lead just typed here may be pulled
	# back with RejectLineRow's Remove button (see removeRejectLine).
	st = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
	st = system.util.jsonDecode(st)
	lines = st.get("rejectLines") or []
	lines.append({"defectCodeId": None, "itemId": None, "quantity": None, "approvedByUserId": None, "isNew": True})
	st["rejectLines"] = lines
	if not self.applyState(st):
		return
	# Bumps every row's seedToken so RejectLineRow re-syncs from params -- the
	# new blank row needs this to pick up its index; existing rows re-adopt
	# their own already-correct values, a no-op for them.
	self.view.custom.rejectLinesSeed = (self.view.custom.rejectLinesSeed or 0) + 1

customMethods.name: changeRejectLine
customMethods.script:
p = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(payload) or {}
	idx = p.get("index")
	if idx is None:
		return
	st = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
	st = system.util.jsonDecode(st)
	lines = st.get("rejectLines") or []
	if 0 <= idx < len(lines):
		# isNew is NOT part of the emitted payload (RejectLineRow only ever
		# knows its own defect/part/qty/approver) -- carry the existing flag
		# forward so editing a pre-seeded line never turns it removable.
		isNew = bool(lines[idx].get("isNew"))
		lines[idx] = {"defectCodeId": p.get("defectCodeId"), "itemId": p.get("itemId"),
		              "quantity": p.get("quantity"), "approvedByUserId": p.get("approvedByUserId"),
		              "isNew": isNew}
		st["rejectLines"] = lines
		if not self.applyState(st):
			return
	# rejectLinesSeed is DELIBERATELY NOT bumped here -- a field edit must not
	# force every other row to re-sync from params (it would clobber whatever
	# a team lead is mid-typing in a different row). Seed is a STRUCTURAL
	# reset signal only (add/remove), matching DieCastEntry/DieWideLineRow.

customMethods.name: removeRejectLine
customMethods.script:
p = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(payload) or {}
	idx = p.get("index")
	if idx is None:
		return
	st = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
	st = system.util.jsonDecode(st)
	lines = st.get("rejectLines") or []
	# Only a locally-staged NEW reject line may be pulled back -- @RejectsJson
	# is an ABSOLUTE target set (Save FULL JOINs it against Workorder.RejectEvent
	# and writes compensating negatives for anything missing), so silently
	# dropping a line already on record would stage a negative RejectEvent
	# against a Honda-traceable record with no confirmation-panel visibility
	# (hasReduction deliberately excludes negative scrap deltas). Mirrors
	# LotLineRow/removeLotLine's isNew guard.
	if 0 <= idx < len(lines) and lines[idx].get("isNew"):
		del lines[idx]
	st["rejectLines"] = lines
	if not self.applyState(st):
		return
	self.view.custom.rejectLinesSeed = (self.view.custom.rejectLinesSeed or 0) + 1

customMethods.name: addLtt
customMethods.script:
U = BlueRidge.Common.Util
	ltt = (U.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.lttInput) or "").strip()
	if not ltt:
		return
	toolId = self.view.params.toolId

	st = system.util.jsonDecode(U.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state))
	lines = st.get("lotLines") or []

	if any([(l.get("ltt") or "") == ltt for l in lines]):
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Already on the list",
			"%s is already on this sheet." % ltt, "info")
		self.view.custom.lttInput = ""
		return

	# Resolved AT THE FIELD, never at save -- the team lead finds out now, with
	# the LOT in their hand, not twenty minutes later on a refused save.
	res = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCastReconciliation.resolveLtt(ltt, toolId)
	result = res.get("Result")

	# Result vocabulary per Lots.DieCastLot_ResolveLtt (verified against the
	# proc source, R__Lots_DieCastLot_ResolveLtt.sql): New | OnThisDie |
	# Elsewhere | Invalid, plus Error from resolveLtt()'s _EMPTY_LTT fallback.
	# (An earlier draft of this handler checked for Foreign/NewLot -- those
	# literals appear nowhere in the SQL or the Python glue and would have let
	# a foreign LTT through instead of refusing it. Corrected here.)
	if result in ("Elsewhere", "Invalid", "Error"):
		# Message is operator-ready prose naming where the LTT belongs.
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("LTT not added", res.get("Message"), "error")
		return

	cavityId = res.get("ToolCavityId") or U.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.lttCavityId)
	if cavityId is None:
		cavs = U.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.cavities) or []
		if len(cavs) == 1:
			cavityId = cavs[0].get("ToolCavityId")
	if cavityId is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Choose a cavity",
			"This die has more than one cavity -- pick the one that cast %s." % ltt, "warning")
		return

	lines.append({"lotId": res.get("LotId"), "ltt": ltt, "toolCavityId": cavityId,
	              "quantity": 0, "isNew": (result == "New")})
	st["lotLines"] = lines
	if not self.applyState(st):
		return
	self.view.custom.lttInput = ""
	# Structural insert -- the grouped LOT list can shift every row's position,
	# so every LotLineRow must reseed from its (possibly new) params, exactly as
	# rejectLinesSeed does for an added/removed reject line.
	self.view.custom.lotLinesSeed = (self.view.custom.lotLinesSeed or 0) + 1

customMethods.name: changeLotQuantity
customMethods.script:
p = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(payload) or {}
	ltt = p.get("ltt")
	if not ltt:
		return
	st = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
	st = system.util.jsonDecode(st)
	lines = st.get("lotLines") or []
	for l in lines:
		if (l.get("ltt") or "") == ltt:
			l["quantity"] = p.get("quantity")
			break
	st["lotLines"] = lines
	if not self.applyState(st):
		return
	# lotLinesSeed is DELIBERATELY NOT bumped here -- a field edit must not
	# force every other row to re-sync from params mid-type (mirrors
	# changeRejectLine).

customMethods.name: removeLotLine
customMethods.script:
p = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(payload) or {}
	ltt = p.get("ltt")
	if not ltt:
		return
	st = BlueRidge.Common.Util.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
	st = system.util.jsonDecode(st)
	lines = st.get("lotLines") or []
	# Only a locally-staged NEW LOT may be pulled back -- nothing is written
	# until the confirmation, so this is purely local, but a line already on
	# record must never silently vanish from what the team lead is reviewing.
	st["lotLines"] = [l for l in lines
	                  if not ((l.get("ltt") or "") == ltt and l.get("isNew"))]
	if not self.applyState(st):
		return
	self.view.custom.lotLinesSeed = (self.view.custom.lotLinesSeed or 0) + 1

customMethods.name: reviewAndSave
customMethods.script:
U = BlueRidge.Common.Util
	st = system.util.jsonDecode(U.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state))
	if st.get("sheetKey") != self.sheetKey():
		# The sheet on screen is no longer the one this draft was typed
		# against. The payload below takes shiftId / cellLocationId / toolId
		# from the LIVE params but its LOT and reject lines from the draft,
		# so previewing it would put one shift's production in front of the
		# team lead as another shift's, on a Honda traceability record.
		# Reload rather than refuse in silence -- the same move the
		# "changed since you opened it" guard below makes.
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Sheet reloaded",
			"This sheet had moved to a different shift. "
			"Check the numbers before saving.", "warning")
		self.load()
		return

	# entryKey is the screen's own undo handle; the proc takes {entityType,
	# entityId, toShiftId} and nothing else.
	moves = [{"entityType": m.get("entityType"), "entityId": m.get("entityId"),
	          "toShiftId": m.get("toShiftId")} for m in (st.get("moves") or [])]
	lots  = [{"lotId": l.get("lotId"), "ltt": l.get("ltt"),
	          "toolCavityId": l.get("toolCavityId"), "quantity": l.get("quantity")}
	         for l in (st.get("lotLines") or [])]

	payload = {
		"shiftId": self.view.params.shiftId,
		"cellLocationId": self.view.params.cellLocationId,
		"toolId": self.view.params.toolId,
		"reasonId": st.get("reasonId"), "note": st.get("note"),
		"actual": st.get("actual") or {},
		"moves": moves, "lots": lots, "rejects": st.get("rejectLines") or [],
		"loadedStamp": st.get("loadedStamp"),
	}

	termId = None
	try:
		termId = self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId
	except:
		termId = None

	res = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCastReconciliation.preview(
		payload, BlueRidge.Common.Session.currentAppUserId(self.session), termId)

	if not res.get("Status"):
		# A preview that refuses is the Save's own refusal, word for word, and
		# it logs nothing -- a half-typed sheet is typing, not failing.
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(res, "")
		if "changed since you opened it" in (res.get("Message") or ""):
			# The stale guard: the shift moved under the team lead while they
			# were filling in the sheet. Reload so they see CURRENT data rather
			# than a sheet that can never save again.
			self.load()
		return

	system.perspective.openPopup("mpp-dc-recon-confirm",
		"BlueRidge/Components/Popups/DieCastReconcileConfirm",
		params={"popupId": "mpp-dc-recon-confirm", "replyMessage": "reconcileConfirmed",
			"plan": BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCastReconciliation.planFrom(res),
			"pressName": self.view.custom.header.PressName,
			"payload": payload},
		modal=True, showCloseIcon=True)

customMethods.name: performSave
customMethods.script:
# Re-assert AT THE WRITE, not just at the door. The door gate
	# (DieCastReconcile/view.json onStartup) opens a DISMISSIBLE modal
	# (showCloseIcon=True, overlayDismiss=True -- other flows share the
	# helper, so it stays dismissible), and this mutation fires minutes
	# later, after the confirmation popup sat open -- long enough for a
	# rolling elevation window to lapse, or for the door gate to have been
	# cancelled outright and the whole screen driven while PIN-signed-in
	# only. Mirrors DieMount's handleMount/handleRelease re-assert.
	if not BlueRidge.Common.Session.isElevated(self.session):
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Not saved",
			"Sign in with a supervisor credential to save this reconciliation.", "error")
		# Replays through the same code the door gate uses; its handler
		# (DieCastReconcile onStartup) just lets the screen stand -- it does
		# not retry this write. The team lead clicks Review & Save again once
		# elevated. reviewAndSave (the preview) is deliberately NOT gated the
		# same way: @PreviewOnly = 1 never reaches BEGIN TRANSACTION (Save
		# sec 13a), so there is nothing there for an unauthorized session to
		# write.
		BlueRidge.Common.Session.requireElevation(
			self.session, "DieCastReconcile", "Reconcile a die cast shift", {})
		return
	p = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(payload) or {}
	termId = None
	try:
		termId = self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId
	except:
		termId = None
	res = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCastReconciliation.save(
		p.get("payload"), BlueRidge.Common.Session.currentAppUserId(self.session), termId)
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(res, "Shift reconciled")
	if res.get("Status"):
		system.perspective.sendMessage("reconcileSaved",
			payload={"NewId": res.get("NewId"), "Message": res.get("Message")}, scope="page")
	elif "changed since you opened it" in (res.get("Message") or ""):
		# The stale guard: the shift moved under the team lead while the
		# confirmation popup was open. Reload so they see CURRENT data rather
		# than a sheet that can never save again.
		self.load()

customMethods.name: discardClicked
customMethods.script:
U = BlueRidge.Common.Util
	cur = U.convertWrapperObjectToJson(self.view.custom.state)
	pristine = self.view.custom.pristineStateJson or ""
	if cur == pristine:
		# Clean sheet -- nothing staged since load(), so there is nothing a
		# confirmation popup could be protecting.
		system.perspective.sendMessage("reconcileBackToShifts", scope="page")
		return
	system.perspective.openPopup("mpp-confirm-unsaved",
		"BlueRidge/Components/Popups/ConfirmUnsaved",
		params={"popupId": "mpp-confirm-unsaved", "replyMessage": "confirmUnsavedResult",
			"title": "Unsaved Changes",
			"message": "This reconciliation has unsaved changes. Save them before leaving?",
			"saveLabel": "Review & Save"},
		modal=True, showCloseIcon=True)

transforms.code:
_u = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues
	lines = _u(value) or []

	# Authoritative per-LOT detail (Recorded, PieceCount, IsLocked, LockReason,
	# StatusName, real PartNumber/CavityCode) for every LOT this shift already
	lotsById = {}
	for r in (_u(self.view.custom.lots) or []):
		lid = r.get("LotId")
		if lid is not None:
			lotsById[lid] = r

	# Fallback for a line just staged by the entry bar and not (yet) on
	# view.custom.lots -- a New LOT, or an existing LOT on this die that this
	# shift had not recorded. Cavity/part only; PieceCount/lock status are not
	cavByTc = {}
	for c in (_u(self.view.custom.cavities) or []):
		tcId = c.get("ToolCavityId")
		if tcId is not None:
			cavByTc[tcId] = c

	groups = []
	byKey = {}

	def groupFor(itemId, partNumber, partDescription):
		key = itemId if itemId is not None else ("?" + str(partNumber))
		g = byKey.get(key)
		if g is None:
			g = {"partNumber": partNumber or "Unknown part",
			     "partDescription": partDescription or "", "rows": []}
			byKey[key] = g
			groups.append(g)
		return g

	for ln in lines:
		ln = ln or {}
		lotId = ln.get("lotId")
		ltt = ln.get("ltt") or ""
		toolCavityId = ln.get("toolCavityId")
		qty = ln.get("quantity")
		isNew = bool(ln.get("isNew"))
		lotRow = lotsById.get(lotId) if lotId is not None else None
		cav = cavByTc.get(toolCavityId) if toolCavityId is not None else None

		if lotRow is not None:
			itemId = lotRow.get("ItemId")
			partNumber = lotRow.get("PartNumber")
			partDescription = lotRow.get("PartDescription")
			cavityCode = lotRow.get("CavityCode") or (cav.get("CavityCode") if cav else "?")
			recorded = lotRow.get("Recorded") or 0
			pieceCountBefore = lotRow.get("PieceCount") or 0
			isLocked = bool(lotRow.get("IsLocked"))
			lockReason = lotRow.get("LockReason") or ""
			stateLabel = lotRow.get("StatusName") or ""
		else:
			itemId = cav.get("ItemId") if cav else None
			partNumber = (cav.get("PartNumber") if cav else None) or "Unknown part"
			partDescription = cav.get("PartDescription") if cav else ""
			cavityCode = cav.get("CavityCode") if cav else "?"
			recorded = 0
			pieceCountBefore = 0
			isLocked = False
			lockReason = ""
			stateLabel = ("New LOT -- created at save" if isNew
			              else "Existing LOT on this die")

		pieceCountAfter = pieceCountBefore + ((qty or 0) - recorded)
		g = groupFor(itemId, partNumber, partDescription)
		g["rows"].append({
			"ltt": ltt, "cavityCode": cavityCode, "quantity": qty,
			"recorded": recorded, "isLocked": isLocked, "lockReason": lockReason,
			"stateLabel": stateLabel, "pieceCountBefore": pieceCountBefore,
			"pieceCountAfter": pieceCountAfter, "isNew": isNew,
		})

	# Sub-total is what the team lead actually reads off the sheet: it MUST
	seed = self.view.custom.lotLinesSeed or 0
	out = []
	for g in groups:
		subTotal = sum([(r.get("quantity") or 0) for r in g["rows"]])
		out.append({
			"rowKind": "group",
			"groupLabel": g["partNumber"],
			"groupDetail": (((g["partDescription"] + " -- ") if g["partDescription"] else "")
			                + "sub-total " + "{:,}".format(subTotal)),
			"seedToken": seed,
		})
		for r in g["rows"]:
			row = dict(r)
			row["rowKind"] = "lot"
			row["seedToken"] = seed
			out.append(row)
	return out

	if not rows:

	# One line PER ROW, never flattened -- two approvers on one code stay two

	lines = []

		appr = r.get("ApprovedBy") or "Unapproved"
		lines.append((r.get("DefectCode") or "?") + " - " + part + " - " + "{:,}".format(r.get("Quantity") or 0) + " pcs - " + appr)

_u = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues
	rows = _u(value) or []
	defectOpts = BlueRidge.Quality.DefectCode.getForDropdown("DieCast") or []
	# Part dropdown: All (itemId null) plus the die's distinct parts, off the
	# same cavity set the LTT bar and the Save both resolve from.
	cavRows = _u(self.view.custom.cavities) or []
	seen = set()
	partOpts = [{"label": "All", "value": None}]
	for c in cavRows:
		iid = c.get("ItemId")
		if iid is None or iid in seen:
			continue
		seen.add(iid)
		partOpts.append({"label": c.get("PartNumber") or ("Item %s" % iid), "value": iid})
	apprOpts = _u(self.view.custom.approverOptions) or []
	seed = self.view.custom.rejectLinesSeed or 0
	out = []
	for i, r in enumerate(rows):
		r = r or {}
		out.append({

			"defectCodeId": r.get("defectCodeId"),
			"itemId": r.get("itemId"),
			"quantity": r.get("quantity"),
			"approvedByUserId": r.get("approvedByUserId"),
			"defectOptions": defectOpts,
			"partOptions": partOpts,
			"approverOptions": apprOpts,
			"isNew": bool(r.get("isNew")),
			"seedToken": seed,
